reason: In a normal week I already share summarized PDFs in Zalo and Discord with classmates, and a 15-second timer with a 4-second reading lock sounds stressful when I'm studying late at night and just want fast answers. Since joining friends' /arena quiz rooms and trying a solo deck are free anyway, I wouldn't pay for a 7-day pass right now.
objection: A 4-second reading lock and 15-second countdown feel slow and stressful for quantitative courses when I just want quick answers and clean formulas, and paying for a 7-day cram pass in a normal week feels unnecessary.
would_change_my_mind: An untimed mode without the 4-second reading lock so I can get fast answers and formula cheat sheets during late-night review.
